mentions.name: sidewaysdata.com
mentions.description: sidewaysdata.com is an event timing platform. Coming soon is a full automated training system to certify people to time events: it spins up a VM with the site's timing software and an emulator of the trainee's chosen hardware, and the trainee plays a game-like simulation dealing with real radio traffic and realistic scenarios where things go wrong to get certified, so people no longer have to be trained from zero at live events.
mentions.problem: People currently have to be trained to time events starting from zero at the events themselves; this automates that training beforehand.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Working on sidewaysdata.com a lot :)

Coming soon is a full automated training system to "certify" people to time events.

It'll spin up a VM with our timing software and an emulator of the hardware of your chosing and you kind of play a game to get certified (you deal with real radio traffic, real world like scenarios where shit goes wrong)... This way we don't have to train people AT events from zero.
